verhaal.metaTitle: Our Story | Schaaps Vis Leiden — Founded in 1938
verhaal.metaDesc: From Gerrit Schaap to the fourth generation — the history of Schaap's Vishandel in Leiden since 1938.
verhaal.heroTitle: From Gerrit Schaap to the fourth generation
verhaal.intro: For more than 86 years, a small, cosy fish shop on Herenstraat in Leiden has fed, delighted and connected generations of Leiden residents. Schaap's Vishandel is not just a shop — it is a piece of Leiden history.
verhaal.t1text: Gerrit Schaap opens his fish shop at Herenstraat 48 in Leiden. At a time when fish truly came fresh from the boat and every Leiden resident had their own fishmonger, Gerrit lays the foundation for what would grow into a city institution.
verhaal.t2text: Young Cor Haasnoot starts working for Mr Schaap at just thirteen years old. He learns the trade from the ground up and takes over the business in 1957. The name "Schaap" stays — a tribute to the founder who has become inseparably linked to the shop.
verhaal.t3text: Aldert Haasnoot — known simply as "Schaap" in the neighbourhood — has stood behind the counter his entire life. In 2009 he officially takes over from his father, bringing the shop into the 21st century while preserving the atmosphere Leiden residents cherish: personal, warm, honest.
verhaal.t3quote: People come here not just for the fish, but for the conversation. I hear everything — sometimes it's like a village pub in here.
verhaal.t4text: On 1 January 2018, Schaap's Vis turns 80. The whole city celebrates. Customers, former employees and neighbours share memories and photos for an anniversary book. One of the most charming: Ria Verburg, who collected kibbeling monthly for the nursery.
verhaal.t4quote: When picking up he always said: 'a box of kibbeling for the orphanage!' It always made me laugh.
verhaal.t5text: Schaap's Vis is preparing for the next generation. The shop has expanded to the Leiden market (Wednesday and Saturday) and to Voorschoten (Hoogvliet, Friday). The range has grown to include premium products such as Vårlaks organic salmon — but the core remains the same: honest, fresh fish with a personal story.
verhaal.outro: Little has changed about the cosy shop on Herenstraat. And that is exactly the point.
verhaal.outroQuote: We are a lovely old little shop. Not everything has to be brand new and spick and span.
verhaal.cta: Come and experience it yourself. You are most welcome.

varlaks.metaTitle: Vårlaks Organic Salmon | Fresh at Schaaps Vis Leiden
varlaks.metaDesc: Vårlaks: premium organic salmon from the Arctic waters of Norway. Free from antibiotics, hormones and GMO. Fresh at Schaaps Vis in Leiden.
varlaks.heroTitle: Vårlaks — organic salmon from the Arctic waters of Norway
varlaks.heroSub: Free from antibiotics, hormones and GMO. Pure nature — you can taste it.
varlaks.intro: At Schaap's Vis we believe in honest fish with a clear story. That is why we offer Vårlaks: a premium organic salmon, raised by family farms above the Arctic Circle in Norway, in the clearest and coldest water in the world.
varlaks.f1text: Vårlaks salmon grow in the ice-cold, oxygen-rich waters of northern Norway — above the Arctic Circle, where conditions are ideal for salmon that grow slowly and naturally.
varlaks.f2text: Vårlaks works exclusively with carefully selected family businesses. Farms are visited personally each year to guarantee quality and sustainability. From egg to end product — fully traceable.
varlaks.f3title: No antibiotics, no GMO, no hormones
varlaks.f3text: Thanks to low stocking density and the pure environment, antibiotics simply have no place in this farming concept. The salmon grow with natural feed, plenty of space and no chemical additives.
varlaks.f4text: Every portion of Vårlaks salmon delivers more than 20 grams of protein per 100 grams, plus a high content of omega-3 fatty acids — good for heart, brain and joints.
varlaks.f5text: From pan-fried to smoked, from grilled to raw (sashimi quality): the firm texture and subtle, full flavour of Vårlaks salmon works in any preparation.
varlaks.cta: Come and taste the difference yourself.
